note: Accounting app on Spring Boot 4.1: Thymeleaf 3.1 with the Spring Security dialect, htmx 2 and the Alpine.js CSP build, behind a strict nonce CSP. 258 templates (255 render from pages.txt; layouts/print, mfa-verify and setup do not). Needs JDK 25 (unnamed variables). PostgreSQL only: start.sh creates a throwaway cluster with the integration-test seed plus seed/. Apache-2.0.
